key.rubymod.ping: Ping (mark a spot on your map)
key.rubymod.help: How to Play / Controls: Show or Hide
item.rubymod.practice_dummy.desc: Put it up in your base for a minute: your Sentry Turrets and Tesla Coils fire on it, and you're told what hit it. Nothing is used up or lost.
block.rubymod.belt_ramp.desc: A belt that carries things up a level (right-click with an empty hand to make it carry them down).
death.attack.rubymod.turret.player: %1$s was gunned down by %2$s's sentry turret
key.rubymod.park_map: Park Map: Fly Anywhere (in the hub)
block.rubymod.ruby_block.desc: Nine rubies, packed. The Trade Depot pays nine times a ruby for it.
block.rubymod.ruby_ore.desc: Mine it for rubies: deep underground, or in the Ruby Crater.
block.rubymod.deepslate_ruby_ore.desc: Mine it for rubies: the deeper ore pays the same.
block.rubymod.ruby_heart.desc: Place it to claim your base. On Battle Day you come back here while it stands.
block.rubymod.armory.desc: Right-click to buy guns, vehicles, defenses and machines, and to upgrade your Heart.
block.rubymod.sandbags.desc: Cheap cover: soaks up bullets, but one blast knocks it down.
block.rubymod.concrete_wall.desc: A tough wall block: takes 4 blasts. Cruise missiles break it at once.
block.rubymod.reinforced_concrete.desc: The toughest wall: takes 6 blasts, and grenades can't hurt it. Cruise missiles break it at once.
block.rubymod.blast_door.desc: A heavy door that only you (and players you trust) can open.
block.rubymod.sentry_turret.desc: Shoots monsters, and enemy players from Open War on. Needs no power. Try it out on a Practice Dummy.
block.rubymod.missile_interceptor.desc: Shoots down missiles and shells headed for your base.
block.rubymod.radar_station.desc: Shows enemies coming on your HUD.
block.rubymod.alarm_block.desc: Sounds when someone steps into your base who shouldn't.
block.rubymod.ruby_bearing.desc: Spins the blocks stuck to its face when powered: build turning doors and gates.
block.rubymod.ruby_piston.desc: Slides the blocks in front of it up to eight blocks when powered: walls, doors, lifts.
block.rubymod.keycard_reader.desc: Gives a redstone signal for a few seconds when someone with your keycard uses it.
block.rubymod.security_camera.desc: Watches your base: see through it on a Monitor.
block.rubymod.monitor.desc: Shows what your Security Cameras see.
block.rubymod.laser_tripwire.desc: A beam that gives a redstone signal when an enemy breaks it.
block.rubymod.keycard_door.desc: Opens only for you, players you trust, or whoever holds your keycard.
block.rubymod.seismic_sensor.desc: Feels digging and tunneling under your base, and warns you.
block.rubymod.flak_cannon.desc: Fills the sky with flak: shreds aircraft.
block.rubymod.sam_site.desc: Locks on to aircraft and fires missiles.
block.rubymod.airfield_pad.desc: Where your aircraft park and rearm.
block.rubymod.at_mine.desc: Blows up enemy vehicles that drive over it.
block.rubymod.claymore.desc: Goes off when an enemy walks in front of it.
block.rubymod.landmine.desc: Goes off when an enemy steps on it.
block.rubymod.barbed_wire.desc: Slows anyone who walks through it.
block.rubymod.mortar.desc: Lobs shells at a spot you mark with the Rangefinder.
block.rubymod.missile_silo.desc: Fires a cruise missile at a spot you choose.
block.rubymod.reinforced_glass.desc: Bulletproof glass: stops small arms, takes 2 blasts.
block.rubymod.conveyor.desc: Carries things the way it points, into whatever is at the end. Curves by itself where a belt joins its side. Redstone stops it.
block.rubymod.belt_loader.desc: Takes things out of the chest, furnace or machine behind it, onto the belt in front. Right-click with an item to take only that.
block.rubymod.belt_sorter.desc: A belt piece that turns one kind of item off to the side. Right-click with an item to choose; empty hand swaps sides.
block.rubymod.floodlight.desc: A bright light for your base.
block.rubymod.elevator.desc: Stand on it and jump to go up to the next one; crouch to go down.
block.rubymod.camo_net.desc: Hides what's under it from the air.
block.rubymod.holo_camo.desc: Copies any block's look. You walk through it; enemies hit a wall.
item.rubymod.night_goggles.desc: Wear them to see in the dark.
block.rubymod.belt_splitter.desc: A belt piece that shares what comes in between its left and its right, turn about.
block.rubymod.belt_tunnel.desc: Place two facing the same way, up to 7 blocks apart: things go in one and out the other, under walls and floors.
block.rubymod.assembler.desc: Crafts what you pick: ingots into blocks, torches, rails, TNT and more. Belts can feed it.
block.rubymod.ore_silo.desc: Holds 128 stacks of one thing. Right-click with an item to store it (twice quickly: all of it), with an empty hand to take a stack. Belts and hoppers work with it.
item.rubymod.prospector_pick.desc: Right-click: it chimes and sparkles toward the nearest Ruby Ore within 16 blocks.
item.rubymod.geode.desc: Right-click to crack it open for a surprise.
